segments.text: - Modelar APIs RESTful seguindo a abordagem API First (Swagger/OpenAPI).

- Technical fluency close to engineering: you can read code, write a script, call an API, and use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) comfortably. You don’t need to ship production code, but you should hold your own with engineers and PMs and translate complex AI features for technical and non-technical audiences alike
- Expert knowledge of SQL and proficiency in R and/or Python for statistical computing
